details: a to b: Under the Regional Connectivity Scheme-Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik (RCS-UDAN), six airports namely Birpur, Saharsa, Munger, Valmiki Naggar, Madhubani, and Muzaffarpur have been identified for development and operation of small aircraft (Category 2B) under the scheme.

details: c: Sarvodaya Ashram Khadi Village Industry being an old Khadi Institution, State Government is being approached for making a revival plan of the Khadi activities and establishment of effective management in the Institution.

records.title: Increase in Cyber Crimes.
details: xxi. The Hon'ble Prime Minister has directed to set up a special branch of trained 'Cyber Commandos'. The objective of 'Cyber Commandos' is to train Cyber Commandos from various ranks in States, Union Territories and Central Police Organisations with candidates selected on the basis of their expertise in computer networks and operating systems. Once trained, these commandos will act as a national resource within their respective organizations, specializing in areas like digital forensics, incident response, and ICT infrastructure security.
